text:
chris: quick sync re: post-RFC for kernel decision gating and fallback plan. want to land a concrete runbook + flag schema today.
anya: yep. i pushed a draft in the rfc thread but it was high level. we need concrete flag names + semantics for per-model overrides and global fallbacks.
mike: +1. Also need to define telemetry signals that will auto-open a rollback. latency p95 spike? >20ms over baseline for 5m? error-rate bump?
tian: for metrics proposal: use p50/p95 latency, token-cost delta, and topk nll regression on a canned eval set. thresholds should be model-specific.
helena: ops concern: Dedicated/Private customers may not accept automatic kernel swaps. add an opt-out tag or admin-only toggle for private deployments.
chris: agreed. proposal: three-layer flag model -> global default, model-level override, deployment-profile (dedicated/private) guard. semantics: model-level overrides take precedence; deployment-profile can disable auto-rollout.
anya: naming suggestion (yaml):
```
flags:
  runtime.kernel.auto_rollout: true
  runtime.kernel.model_overrides.<model_id>.enable_kernels: [v2, v1]
  runtime.kernel.deployment_profile.<profile>.allow_auto_rollout: false
```
mike: that looks good. also add a `fallback_order` array per model so runtime knows which kernel to try next when a kernel fails.
tian: fallback_order example: `fallback_order: [v2, v1, cpu-emulated]`
helena: what about partial rollouts? we need gradual ramps (1%, 10%, 50%) and canary by user-segment or traffic shard. Also need ABI compatibility checks before enabling (kv-cache layout, quantization format).
chris: proposed rollout phases: canary (N hosts), ramp-by-traffic-percent, scale. each phase needs automated smoke checks (latency, errors, eval set score). failing checks => immediate rollback + incident channel ping.
anya: how do we express checks in infra? new rollout_check object with check_type, window, threshold, action. pseudo: 
```
rollout_check:
  - name: p95_latency
    type: latency_p95
    window: 5m
    threshold: +20%
    action: rollback
```
helena: add `notify: [#oncall, #runtime]` to ensure alerts. and `auto_disable_after_retries` so failing rollouts don't keep flipping.
mike: one more: telemetry tag to bind tokens/requests to model_version+kernel so we can slice cost and quality by kernel. mandatory for any enabled kernel.
tian: implement in tracing: add attributes `kernel.name`, `kernel.version`, `model.variant`. easy.
chris: next: API surface for users (internal teams) to opt in per-route. minimal change: extend model config manifest with `enabled_kernels` + `rollout_policy_ref`.
anya: followup tasks: 1) PR for flag schema + validation (mike) 2) rollout_check proto + infra integration (tian) 3) console UI for manual override and rollout progress (helena) 4) docs + runbook (anya)
mike: i'll start PR for schema and a small unit test harness to simulate fallback_order. ETA EOD tomorrow.
tian: i'll add rollout_check to metrics pipeline and wire a canary check. need help with baseline computation - chris?
chris: i'll hand you the baseline job and eval harness. will also add synthetic load jobs for canary hosts.
anya: ok i'm going to consolidate this into a short playbook and add it to the RFC thread. also add snippet for the oncall playbook: what to do on rollback.
helena: please include steps to manually force kernel v1 for all hosts and to mark a kernel as deprecated.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled job created: canary-hosts-smoke-check at 1738260000.
chris: thanks. good progress. if no objections i'll open the feature-flag PR and link to this thread.
